title: Evidence capture and parity specification
baseline: Published reference inspected; authenticated workflows unverified.

tasks.title: Capture authenticated screen and workflow inventory
tasks.acceptance: Record navigation, URLs, fields, filters, validations, empty/error/loading states and desktop/mobile screenshots for every accessible module; label plan-gated screens. Resolve current blank-page browser behavior before claiming login success.

tasks.title: Document observed API contracts and domain state machines
tasks.acceptance: Capture redacted request/response schemas from normal authorized UI use; map order, confirmation, parcel, return and settlement transitions with actor and stock/cash effects. No inferred endpoint may be marked observed.

tasks.title: Publish signed-off feature parity and Morea gap matrix
tasks.acceptance: For every feature record source, observation level, existing Morea path, gap, priority and acceptance scenario; split verified behavior from published claims and product choices.

title: Tenant access, roles and operational shell
baseline: Store tenancy, staff, platform admin and FR/EN/AR already exist.

tasks.title: Specify operator roles and store switching
tasks.acceptance: Map Cashod role/store visibility after login; design membership permissions beyond current User.belongs_to store; test deny-by-default access and cross-tenant denial for UI, jobs, GraphQL and MCP.

tasks.title: Design dense responsive operations navigation
tasks.acceptance: Map modules into Morea admin while preserving storefront UX; specify RTL, keyboard navigation, tables, saved filters and accessible error states.

tasks.title: Harden sessions and audit actor identity
tasks.acceptance: Specify optional 2FA, session expiry/revocation, privileged actions and actor/source audit events; validate session and token tenant boundaries in isolated tests.

title: Order intake, deduplication and COD lifecycle
baseline: Order model already has transitions, edits, archive/tags/events, cancellation and stock reservation.

tasks.title: Unify external order ingestion and duplicate detection
tasks.acceptance: Define source IDs and idempotency keys; repeat delivery creates one order; normalize Moroccan phones; flag likely duplicates without deleting legitimate repeat purchases.

tasks.title: Extend the existing order desk from observed parity gaps
tasks.acceptance: Map reference statuses to Order::TRANSITIONS; specify bulk actions, filters, timelines, assignments, validation and edit locks; preserve carrier-owned statuses and existing order history.

tasks.title: Specify deposits and remaining COD balance
tasks.acceptance: Define deposit recording/reversal, minor-unit currency arithmetic and collectible remainder; carrier amount must equal agreed outstanding balance; prevent overpayment and double counting.

title: Call-center confirmation and agent performance
baseline: No dedicated call-center tables identified in schema.

tasks.title: Design confirmation queue and fair assignment
tasks.acceptance: Specify callback precedence, assignment rules, concurrent claim locks and reassignment; two agents cannot claim the same order; store and role scope enforced.

tasks.title: Model call attempts, outcomes and callbacks
tasks.acceptance: Record agent, timestamps, duration, disposition and next callback; reference observations determine confirmation/cancellation transitions; unanswered attempts cannot silently confirm orders.

tasks.title: Define agent reporting and commissions
tasks.acceptance: Specify denominator for contact/confirmation/delivery rates and commission eligibility/reversals; fixture totals reconcile to call and delivered-order events.

title: WhatsApp inbox and AI confirmation
baseline: No WhatsApp inbox/AI confirmation module identified.

tasks.title: Design official WhatsApp connection and shared inbox
tasks.acceptance: Document provider setup, template approval, consent, delivery receipts and tenant-bound conversations; duplicate webhook must not duplicate messages; no live customer messages during discovery.

tasks.title: Specify button confirmation and timed follow-ups
tasks.acceptance: Model confirm/cancel buttons, expiry, already-shipped orders, fallback to call center and opt-out; each event changes an order at most once.

tasks.title: Design multilingual AI with human handoff
tasks.acceptance: Specify Darija/AR/FR/EN/ES evaluation fixtures, confidence policy, source-grounded answers, tool permissions, handoff and spend limits; low-confidence or conflicting customer requests require human review.

title: Carrier adapters, shipment lifecycle and delivery runs
baseline: Sendit integration, polling, labels and webhooks already exist.

tasks.title: Extract a carrier contract around existing Sendit behavior
tasks.acceptance: Specify create/cancel/label/track capabilities, error taxonomy and status mapping; preserve Sendit ownership, retries and idempotency; prove with recorded/sandbox fixtures.

tasks.title: Prioritize and specify additional carrier integrations
tasks.acceptance: Validate Cashod carrier list and per-carrier fields/coverage from authorized screens and vendor docs; deliver adapter matrix and first additional carrier contract; do not promise all carriers without evidence.

tasks.title: Design carrier rules and own-courier delivery runs
tasks.acceptance: Specify ordered assignment rules, fallback, driver manifests, partial delivery, proof and cash handover; rerunning assignment cannot create duplicate parcels.

title: Returns, warehouses and stock costing
baseline: Inventory movements, variants and reservation lifecycle exist; no warehouse/FIFO tables identified.

tasks.title: Specify return receipt and disposition lifecycle
tasks.acceptance: Separate carrier returned from physical receipt; scan/inspect accepted, damaged and missing items; restock once only and reconcile fees without rewriting shipment history.

tasks.title: Design warehouse balances and immutable stock ledger
tasks.acceptance: Extend existing movements to locations, transfers, reservations and adjustments; concurrent reservations cannot oversell and ledger/balances reconcile by store, SKU and warehouse.

tasks.title: Specify FIFO cost lots and delivered COGS
tasks.acceptance: Define lot allocation, partial consumption, returns and cost corrections; deterministic fixtures reconcile quantity/value and prevent negative cost-lot balances.

tasks.title: Model suppliers and purchase order workflow
tasks.acceptance: Specify unit costs, MOQ, lead times, draft/ordered/partial/received/cancelled transitions and access; receiving twice cannot duplicate stock.

tasks.title: Design partial receipt and supplier balances
tasks.acceptance: Specify receipts, costs, payments and outstanding balances; stock lots created atomically with accepted receipt quantities and reconcile to supplier ledger.

tasks.title: Specify made-to-order planning calendar
tasks.acceptance: Map requested dates to daily SKU demand, available stock and planned production; define rescheduling, timezone, cancellation and shortage behavior.

title: Customer identity and risk signals
baseline: Customer records and admin customer pages exist.

tasks.title: Design tenant-safe customer identity and history
tasks.acceptance: Validate whether reference identity spans stores; define explicit merchant boundary, normalized phones, merge/unmerge and event provenance; no cross-merchant customer exposure.

tasks.title: Specify VIP, blacklist and duplicate review controls
tasks.acceptance: Capture reason, actor, date and override permission; risk flags explain decisions and never silently discard paid or valid customer orders.

tasks.title: Define customer search, retention and export access
tasks.acceptance: Specify masked list views, authorized detail access, retention/deletion rules and export auditing; fixture tests enforce tenant and role restrictions.

title: COD reconciliation, accounting and profitability
baseline: Platform subscription invoices exist; these are distinct from merchant COD settlements.

tasks.title: Design carrier remittance and invoice matching
tasks.acceptance: Model expected COD, deposits, delivery/return fees, received cash, discrepancies and settlement state; duplicate statement import cannot book money twice.

tasks.title: Specify merchant expense and cash ledgers
tasks.acceptance: Separate merchant accounting from platform invoices; define immutable entries, reversals, receivables and balances; reconcile opening plus movements to closing balances.

tasks.title: Define P&L and operational KPI semantics
tasks.acceptance: Document revenue recognition, FIFO COGS, courier fees, returns, commissions, ad spend and expenses; publish hand-calculated delivered/returned/partial-settlement fixtures and timezone rules.

title: Workflow automation and reliable event processing
baseline: Sidekiq, scheduled jobs and Sendit polling already exist.

tasks.title: Design event/outbox and deduplicated job execution
tasks.acceptance: Specify tenant-bound events, transaction boundaries, idempotent consumers, retry/backoff and dead-letter handling; crash/replay cannot duplicate shipments or stock movements.

tasks.title: Specify trigger-condition-delay-action workflows
tasks.acceptance: Map published triggers to observed UI; define conditions, delays, cancellation, versioning and safe preview; limit dangerous actions by permission and environment.

tasks.title: Design run history, replay and operational alerts
tasks.acceptance: Specify redacted logs, correlation IDs, dry-run, scoped replay and alert thresholds; failed external actions remain visible with actionable recovery.

title: Store integrations, public API and MCP parity
baseline: GraphQL, MCP and OAuth with store tokens already exist.

tasks.title: Design external commerce and Sheets connectors
tasks.acceptance: Prioritize Shopify then validate YouCan/WooCommerce/LightFunnels/Storeep/xPage/Sheets demand; specify mapping, cursors, retries, sync conflicts and import reconciliation.

tasks.title: Specify scoped developer API and webhook contracts
tasks.acceptance: Compare existing GraphQL/MCP with published REST capability; decide REST needs via ADR; define scopes, key rotation, pagination, idempotency, webhook signatures and rate limits.

tasks.title: Extend existing MCP coverage and safety contracts
tasks.acceptance: Map accepted modules to tools/resources; preserve preview/apply/verify and authorization semantics; test schema compatibility, tenant scope and safe errors without secrets.

title: Advertising attribution and campaign rules
baseline: Pixels/tracking settings exist; ad-account reporting/rules not established.

tasks.title: Specify ad account connection and COD attribution
tasks.acceptance: Validate Meta/TikTok/Google/Snapchat screens and vendor permissions; define attribution keys/windows, timezone and spend freshness; track unmatched spend explicitly.

tasks.title: Define delivered-profit campaign reporting
tasks.acceptance: Join spend to confirmed/delivered/returned orders using versioned attribution rules; verify against accounting fixtures and show stale/missing data.

tasks.title: Design guarded campaign automation
tasks.acceptance: Validate which vendors support pause/enable/budget rules; specify dry-run, limits, cooldowns, audit and rollback; no live budget changes during reverse engineering.

title: SaaS plans, migration and release acceptance
baseline: Manual platform invoices and soft past-due banners already exist.

tasks.title: Specify plan entitlements and usage metering
tasks.acceptance: Verify current Cashod pricing/limits before adopting; design store/order/user metering and limit behavior; preserve existing manual billing until an explicit payment-provider decision.

tasks.title: Plan additive migrations and staged rollout
tasks.acceptance: Provide ADRs, backfill/reconciliation scripts, feature flags, rollback boundaries and backup/restore rehearsal; preserve Morea storefront, tenant URLs, API contracts and current order data.

tasks.title: Define end-to-end parity and operational readiness gate
tasks.acceptance: Use synthetic tenants for intake→confirmation→shipment→delivery/return→settlement plus duplicate, failure and replay cases; require tenant security, accessibility/RTL, load thresholds, monitoring and owner sign-off before release.
